newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila banks' H1 assets reach 1.67 trillion pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila banks' H1 assets reach 1.67 trillion pesos.

text.p: Total assets of the Philippine commercial banking system reached 1.67 trillion pesos as of end-June, up by 8.5 percent from the end-March level of 1.54 trillion pesos, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.
The Bank said in a statement that the growth in resources was manifested by the expansion in loans to 1.023 trillion as of end-June, 10.8 percent more than the end-March level of 923.2 billion pesos.
Deposits reached 988.4 billion pesos by the first half of the year, 4.4 percent more than end-March 946.5 billion pesos figure.
